races.paceDynamic: Greedy Smith is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable gallop from the start without pressure from other pace angles. Future Times and Klervia may sit prominent but neither has the profile to challenge Greedy Smith's early control. This creates a steady tempo through the early stages before the race builds from halfway as the hold-up horses begin their moves. The lack of genuine pace pressure and sustainable gallop strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Holds Up
scenarios.trigger: If Greedy Smith maintains control without being pressed hard through halfway
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop allows him to kick clear in the straight while prominent horses like Future Times and Klervia benefit from the steady tempo to mount challenges. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Greedy Smith sets too steady a pace and fades dramatically from 2 out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where hold-up horses with fresh legs can close strongly up the hill. Man Oh Man and Vengeance benefit most from being able to unleash late kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Future Times or Klervia press Greedy Smith from 3 out onwards
scenarios.body: A tactical battle develops between the pace-setters in the straight, allowing one of the prominent horses to outlast the front runner. The moderate early pace still favours those positioned handy.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If all the fancied horses underperform and connections struggle
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with horses making mistakes or failing to fire, opening the door for a bigger-priced runner. Long-absent or unfancied horses capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Greedy Smith's jumping - if he makes early errors under pressure from cheekpieces, the pace scenario completely changes
Future Times with 7lb claimer Mr Stenhouse aboard - inexperienced rider on 20-race maiden could cause interference in prominent positions
Man Oh Man's response to tongue-tie addition after miserable last run - twice placed recently so has ability if headgear helps
Noble Grace and Klervia both hold-up horses making stable debuts after disappointing previous efforts
Dawn's Desire carrying just 142lbs - significant weight advantage if the pace collapses and becomes a staying test

races.paceDynamic: Knight Of Magic stands as the sole confirmed front runner in this field of eight, giving him uncontested control of the early tempo. With all other runners showing hold-up tendencies, Knight Of Magic can dictate a comfortable, sustainable gallop without pressure through the first half of this 2m2½f contest. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will likely be steady rather than strong, allowing the field to stay bunched heading into the final half-mile. This scenario clearly favours horses with finishing kick ability who can travel well off the moderate pace and produce their best effort late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Knight Of Magic gets his own way in front and maintains energy for a finishing kick
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows Knight Of Magic to save something for the finish while the hold-up horses may struggle to make up ground on forgiving fractions. Sean Bowen can time his effort perfectly from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace sets up a sprint finish where class tells
scenarios.body: The bunched field turning for home creates a cavalry charge where Madame De Labrunie's French winning experience and superior RPR rating prove decisive. Jonathan Burke can produce her with a well-timed challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Knight Of Magic fades badly and leaves a tactical mess
scenarios.body: His long absence and poor recent hurdling record catch up as he weakens, creating a muddling affair where any horse with stamina can capitalise. The race becomes a test of who stays strongest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Total Tactical Breakdown
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can establish any rhythm or sustained challenge
scenarios.body: Multiple horses get in each other's way in the straight with no clear pace foundation established throughout. The winner emerges from chaos rather than tactical superiority.

watchPoints.text: Knight Of Magic's jumping - returning hurdler after 308 days with 0-6 record over obstacles could make costly errors
Madame De Labrunie's position turning for home - needs clear racing room to unleash her finishing kick from hold-up position
Sharp Tor and Callum Pritchard's 3lb claim - the partnership needs to avoid getting blocked in the straight when making their move
First-time headgear on Getone - the visor could spark improvement for Daisy Hitchins' new recruit
How quickly Knight Of Magic establishes his lead - if he goes too fast early he'll set it up for the closers

races.paceDynamic: Circle Of Secrets looks the only natural leader in this small field and should be allowed an uncontested lead from flagfall. The prominent runners Son Of Hypnos and Blacksamssenorita will track the pace without applying serious pressure, while hold-up horses Western Cross and Arnie Moon will need the tempo to quicken late. With only one pace-setter and no obvious pace pressure, Circle Of Secrets can dictate terms and create a pedestrian gallop that builds gradually. This tactical scenario strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Circle dictates throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Circle Of Secrets gets an easy lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: The front-runner can string out the field turning for home and prove tough to peg back when the hold-up horses make their moves too late. This controlled pace scenario heavily favours the leader and those positioned prominently.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent duo take over
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Hypnos and Blacksamssenorita move up to pressure Circle Of Secrets approaching two out
scenarios.body: The pace quickens earlier than ideal for the hold-up pair, and the prominent runners can kick clear while Western Cross and Arnie Moon are still making ground. Superior fitness and tactical position wins out.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses time it
scenarios.trigger: If Circle Of Secrets sets a genuine gallop or fades entering the straight
scenarios.body: Western Cross and Arnie Moon get the strong pace they need to unleash their finishing kicks from off the tempo. The early leaders pay for their efforts as the closers arrive with perfectly timed challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Circle Of Secrets goes too slowly and no one takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where class and natural speed matter most. Fresh legs and tactical positioning from midfield become crucial in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Circle Of Secrets could steal this if allowed to dictate terms unopposed and string out the field turning for home
Watch Son Of Hypnos and Blacksamssenorita early to see if either moves up to apply pace pressure before the straight
Western Cross needs to be held up longer than usual given the likely lack of early pace from this small field
Arnie Moon's 3lb claimer must judge the pace perfectly as hold-up tactics become harder with limited early speed
Track condition remains good throughout the card so no horses have going concerns to monitor

races.paceDynamic: Prairie Queen will dictate the early tempo as the sole confirmed front-runner, likely getting an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop. With Land Girl's Luck, Loki's Mischief, Carrigmoorna Rowan and He'llstopatthetop all wanting prominent positions, a wall of horses will form 2-3 lengths off the leader, creating potential traffic problems turning for home. The lack of early pace pressure means Prairie Queen can conserve energy for the finish, while the prominent brigade may get boxed in when the race develops. This setup clearly favours front-runners and patient hold-up horses who can avoid the mid-race congestion and find cleaner passages late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Queen gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: She conserves energy through the early stages and has enough left to resist late challenges when the prominent horses get in each other's way. The tactical advantage of a clean run throughout proves decisive in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge Late
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates significant interference 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses like Senor Diaz and Holy Legend find clear runs while the prominent group gets shuffled back in traffic. Clean late runs prove superior to tactical speed in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Escapes Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets first run from the pack
scenarios.body: Land Girl's Luck or Carrigmoorna Rowan manages to slip the field before the others can react and sustains their run to the line. Superior class tells when getting a clear passage at the right moment.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Queen stops quickly and the prominent group implodes
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace leaves too many horses with chances turning in, creating a cavalry charge finish. The horse with the best turn of foot rather than position proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: Prairie Queen getting loose on the lead - if uncontested through halfway she becomes very dangerous
Traffic problems 2 out involving Land Girl's Luck, Loki's Mischief and Carrigmoorna Rowan in the prominent pack
Senor Diaz and Holy Legend getting clear runs from the back when the race develops
Amateur riders Mr Henry Main and Mr Jack Stenhouse positioning their mounts early when pace is steady
Loki's Mischief's hood impact after disappointing last run when well-backed

races.name: Irish Thoroughbred Marketing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Saint Cyr De Pail
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who needs to get close enough to Dyno Dave to mount a telling challenge, with recent third suggesting return to form but 21 days since last run could blunt sharpness.

runners_data.name: Mahler Moon
runners_data.note: Course winner who typically races prominently and has solid recent form including a win, though 160lbs represents a decent weight burden for the 8-year-old.

runners_data.name: Dyno Dave
runners_data.note: Front-runner from in-form Henderson yard who should get uncontested lead but must prove 3-mile stamina after recent good-ground course success over shorter.
runners_data.comment: Appreciated getting away from slow ground when a narrow winner here three weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't hang about over hurdles and seemed to appreciate getting away from slow ground when edging home in a C&D good-ground handicap three weeks ago, on only his fourth run over fences; up 5lb but probably improving.

races.paceDynamic: Dyno Dave is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the off, likely getting an uncontested lead in this small field of three. With Saint Cyr De Pail and Mahler Moon both prominent racers rather than pace-pressers, Dyno Dave should be allowed to bowl along at a sustainable gallop without early interference. The lack of pace pressure means the leader can control sectionals and save energy for the business end, while the two chasers will need to time their challenges perfectly over the final half-mile. This tactical scenario strongly favours front-running and early prominent tactics, as the pace-setter gets first run while the prominent pair face the difficult task of reeling in a horse that's had things his own way.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dyno Dave Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Dyno Dave gets the easy lead as expected and maintains strong jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: Henderson's charge can dictate terms throughout and prove hard to peg back when the challengers come hunting in the straight. His recent good-ground C&D success suggests he has the tactical speed to resist late challenges when getting first run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Prominent Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Saint Cyr De Pail or Mahler Moon can get close enough to Dyno Dave turning for home
scenarios.body: The chaser can use superior stamina reserves to overhaul the leader in the final furlong, with Dyno Dave paying for his front-running exertions. Saint Cyr De Pail's recent third and Mahler Moon's course win give both late-challenge credentials.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jumping Error Decisive
scenarios.trigger: If any horse makes a significant mistake at a crucial fence in the straight
scenarios.body: In a tight three-runner affair, one bad jump can immediately end winning chances and hand the race to whichever horse maintains fluency. The mistake-maker drops out of contention while the other two fight out the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the 3-mile trip finds out Dyno Dave's stamina reserves in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: The front-runner's early exertions catch up with him as both prominent racers sweep past in the closing stages. Mahler Moon's proven course form and Saint Cyr De Pail's recent placed efforts suggest both stay the trip better than the leader.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Dyno Dave gets headed before the final fence as front-runners can fold quickly once passed in small fields
Monitor Saint Cyr De Pail's early positioning as he needs to be close enough to strike but not close enough to pressure the leader
Check Mahler Moon's jumping rhythm as any mistake will be costly in a three-runner race with limited recovery opportunities
Watch for any signs of stamina pressure in Dyno Dave from three out onwards as the trip may stretch his reserves
Observe if any horse gets outpaced when the tempo lifts from the back straight as there's nowhere to hide in this field

races.paceDynamic: Daisy Yeats is the only confirmed front runner but returns from a 340-day absence, making her pace reliability questionable. The prominent runners Assassins Lullaby, High Game Royal and Windance will likely fill the early positions, but none are natural pace-forcers over this trip. This creates a moderate tempo early before the race develops into a tactical affair from the back straight. The hold-up horses Franco De Port, Macklin, Stumps Or Slips and Gateau De Miel should benefit from this shape, as they can position perfectly for late challenges when the pace inevitably quickens approaching the final circuit.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves moderate early and the tactical nature suits patient rides
scenarios.body: The pace setters will weaken from 2 out and those held up can unleash finishing kicks. Macklin and Franco De Port are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven late speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If High Game Royal or Windance can dictate fractions and maintain momentum throughout
scenarios.body: They can steal crucial lengths before the hold-up horses get organized, making it difficult for closers to bridge the gap. The tactical pace plays into their hands if they judge it correctly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Daisy Yeats Sets Strong Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Daisy Yeats overcomes her long absence and forces an honest gallop from the start
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will find out the stamina of all runners but particularly suit those with proven staying power. Macklin's class and Franco De Port's Grade 1 background become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If all pace angles fail to materialize and the field goes very slowly until the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where positioning and traffic problems decide the outcome. The handiest positioned horse with a turn of foot wins regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Daisy Yeats must prove her fitness after 340 days off - if she fails to lead the pace scenario changes completely
Franco De Port's jumping under pressure given his long absence and step back up to this longer trip
Macklin's odds will shorten significantly if he travels kindly in the early stages given his recent course win
High Game Royal and Windance battle for prominent positions could set up the race for hold-up horses
Stumps Or Slips positioning in the field given his hold-up style and need to avoid traffic problems
